bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for the workforce homeownership program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER AND APPROPRIATION; WORKFORCE HOMEOWNERSHIP PROGRAM.

(a) $30,250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $30,250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. This transfer is $30,250,000 in fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter.

(b) $30,250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $30,250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for the workforce homeownership program under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.38.
additions: TRANSFER AND APPROPRIATION; WORKFORCE HOMEOWNERSHIP PROGRAM.
